items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: And it turned me into a Jimmy Hoffa or something for the musicians

ctx.x: The artists that you bring in. It probably makes it go pretty good. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -20-

Yeah, yeah. And I’m finding out that that generally is not the case with these jazz societies. I don’t know how many there are in the U.S. now, maybe sixty or something, I’m not sure of that number. But it seems to me that very few of them have an actual practicing workaday musician making any of the booking considerations, which is interesting. I mean I’ve got to hand it to this guy Kurt Stern that organized this thing to put me in that position. Because my immediate position was like that of a union organizer.…
Oh. What are we going to do for this? Yeah.
